# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite backend and Skia m152**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and upgrades to Skia milestone m152. It also adds async pixel readback, a Vulkan Silk.NET package with expanded Vulkan test coverage, and several memory-leak and performance fixes across pixmaps, images and text.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m152** — Bundles the Chrome m152 engine, plus upstream m151 stability fixes merged in along the way. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, letting consumers opt into the newer rendering pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel readback** — Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for non-blocking pixel reads. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan via Silk.NET** — Ships a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and runs Vulkan tests on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Nano Server font support** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server, where the platform font APIs are unavailable. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed native use-after-free bugs** — SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots its owning SKRegion, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* root their pixel source, closing two native use-after-free paths. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Fixed a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak** — SKImage.Create no longer leaks its native pixel buffer when raster creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Faster handle and buffer operations** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration check, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, and pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffect uniform lookup map, reducing overhead on hot paths. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **Fewer allocations in text and encoding paths** — Avoids an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated GetEncodedText path. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))

## Platform

- **Windows native build hardening** — Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build and stops pinning a specific Windows SDK version by default. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))
- **Deterministic binding generation** — Makes binding generation deterministic across platforms and converts all .sln solutions to the newer .slnx format. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612), [#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **New containerized test legs** — Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl and Nano Server test containers to widen platform coverage. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz binding alongside routine maintenance PRs, with no consumer-facing API changes in this release.
